walkthrough: Recall the order of increasing frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum: radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma-rays.
In a vacuum the speed is the same for all, $c = f\lambda$, so frequency $f$ increases as wavelength $\lambda$ decreases along that order.
Infrared is lower frequency and longer wavelength than visible light, so statement A reverses the order.
Radio waves are lower frequency and longer wavelength than microwaves, and gamma-rays are higher frequency than X-rays, so statements B and D also reverse the order.
Ultraviolet follows visible light toward higher $f$ and shorter $\lambda$, so ultraviolet has higher frequency than visible light. This is option C.
